testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.tenancy.TenantFoundationMigrationTests

testcase.name: workspace tenant constraint - a row cannot be moved into a workspace of another tenant()
database constraints reject bad tenants, bad roles and missing tenant ids()
becoming a workspace member makes the user a MEMBER of the workspace tenant and never a TENANT_ADMIN()
legacy insert paths still work - a workspace created without tenant lands in the DEFAULT tenant()
an explicit tenant_id that matches the workspace tenant is accepted()
a user can belong to several tenants()
re-activating a workspace member re-creates the tenant membership, but never re-activates one that was deactivated at tenant level()
an explicit tenant_id that differs from the workspace tenant is REJECTED on every child table, never overwritten()
legacy INSERT without tenant_id still works on every table (compatibility trigger fills it)()
DEFAULT tenant exists and is ACTIVE()
no row of the foundation tables is left without a tenant and children always match their workspace()
moving a workspace to another tenant carries its members and projects along (composite FK ON UPDATE CASCADE)()
